name: King EX80
description: King EX80 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX80E enhancer (1987). Generates new upper harmonics to brighten dull sounds: INPUT with an input light, INTENSITY (how much the harmonic generator is driven), FILTER 1 to 5 kHz (12 dB/oct, the band that feeds it), MIX (how much is added), EFFECT in/out.
author: The Disk King
